protocol: AutoContract H7E zero-operator-body audiomentations EffectV4 holdout
amendment: Before adapter freeze or operator-body inspection, replace resolved coverage with classified coverage because correct fail-closed child/user-callable outcomes are intentionally not fully resolved.

selection_rationale.public_api: documented top-level transforms and composition classes
stressors: random parameters are retained and can be frozen for replay
Lambda invokes an arbitrary user callable
AddBackgroundNoise consumes file-backed external operands and an optional callable

evaluation_context.decision_meaning: admit means the operator effect is complete enough to enter downstream rewrite checking; it does not mean arbitrary operators commute

framework_facts_from_public_docs: waveform transforms accept a NumPy samples array and sample_rate and return a waveform array
ordinary transforms expose probability p and retain their chosen parameters
freeze_parameters reuses retained parameters on later inputs until unfreeze_parameters
Compose executes a sequence of child transforms and may shuffle it
OneOf randomly chooses a child transform
AddBackgroundNoise reads user-selected audio files and may invoke noise_transform
interpretation_rule: Binding integrity is checked before semantic evaluation. Classified coverage counts either a complete admitted effect or a specific fail-closed safety category; generic unknown remains unclassified. The EffectV4 analyzer, audiomentations adapter, protocol, symbol manifest, and thresholds must be frozen before operator bodies are exposed to the adapter author. No repair or rerun on the same holdout is permitted.
